Everything You Need to Know Before Switching

Straightforward answers to the most common questions high-volume merchants ask about underwriting, rates, and onboarding.

Do you support high-risk and regulated industries? +

Yes. We specialize in LegitScript-certified underwriting for dietary supplements, telehealth, online coaching, recurring subscriptions, CBD, and high-ticket B2B services. Unlike automated aggregators that blindly approve accounts and freeze them later, we pre-underwrite your business model upfront so your processing volume is permanently stable.

Is there a long-term contract or cancellation penalty? +

No. We operate strictly on a month-to-month basis. There are zero cancellation fees, zero lock-in agreements, and zero termination penalties. We believe in continuously earning your business every month through lower rates, reliable uptime, and dedicated human support.

How long does approval and account activation take? +

Most merchant accounts are custom-underwritten and approved within 24 to 48 hours. Once approved, our onboarding specialists assist with your gateway API credentials or software integrations so you can begin processing within the same week.

Will switching processors disrupt my active store or sales? +

Zero disruption. Your existing processing account stays 100% active while we configure and test your new gateway routing in the background. We only transition customer traffic once your new account is live and fully verified.

What information is needed for the free Rate Analysis? +

Just your basic monthly card volume and your most recent merchant processing statement. Our team performs an itemized, line-by-line fee comparison showing exactly how much cash you will save each month under Interchange-Plus pricing.

How does Multi-Gateway failover protect my revenue? +

OneFunding connects your checkout to redundant gateway pipelines (including NMI, Authorize.Net, and Fluidpay). If one network route experiences unexpected bank downtime or processing lag, transactions automatically route to a secondary gateway in milliseconds without your customers noticing.
